title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.64: Fixed the Planned selection index badges lingering on a card after you deselect it from hand (they now clear immediately). Added automatic diagnostics that log an error if a badge is ever stranded on a non-selected card, plus a dev-console command 'understudy_badgediag [on|off|dump]' for verbose badge logging.
